purpose: Batch geometry proposals, not production-board promotion or electrical qualification

execution.rules_restore_reason: Even with --no-fix-drc-settings, the tested engine changed min_hole_clearance from 0.25 to 0.15 and added rule_severities. Discard all generated project/rule settings, restore exact baseline copies, then run native DRC. A clean DRC against engine-written rules is not acceptable.
execution.net_selection: Explicit endpoint-reviewed full KiCad net names; never an unreviewed wildcard
execution.fab_overrides_reason: Preserve the existing H6 0.4/0.2-mm via recipe; do not let the engine's generic 0.45-mm floor replace it
execution.warning: Pinned source overrides some README claims. Without these switches it may enroll old copper for rerouting or relax rules. The output writer can also transform unrelated artwork: independent exact preservation checks remain mandatory.

acceptance: All old copper UUIDs and geometry, footprints, pads/nets, outline, zones, stack and non-copper objects unchanged
Added copper only on explicit allowed nets with the exact layer/width/via recipe
Native pad connectivity improves without regression on other nets
Fresh whole-board native KiCad DRC and schematic parity against unchanged project rules
Separate electrical/ESD/return-path and assembly review before production promotion

rf.scope: 7 reserved U42 GPIO pull-down nets, 7 connections

pilot.scope_limit: 67/67 trial connections, not the complete boards. Times exclude initial integration, independent grading/DRC and the discarded first UI pass. No production copper was promoted.
pilot.token_measurement_limit: No comparable per-batch manual-routing token baseline. Zero model calls inside deterministic routing does not mean zero total setup/orchestration/review tokens.
pilot.freerouting_comparison: Installed 2.3.0 with fixed netless obstacles timed out after 180 seconds per board without SES. Its headless settings and obstacle conversion are confounders; this is not a general quality ranking, and 2.4.1 was not benchmarked.
